authority: Static source and data inspection; bounded stdlib synthetic controls only. No compiler, JVM, RTL elaboration, native simulator or model execution. This report is not a build/run GO.

chunk_boundary.K_order: Chunk-major, then depth-major, then causal-key. Token16/head0 first chunk ends 0x203dc0; second chunk is 0x204000 through0x2041c0. Not depth-major across all17 keys.
chunk_boundary.max: Max resets to -Inf at each head Q-load completion, not each chunk. Second chunk all scan/fold/scale/retire max is inherited +0. Every global key0 retirement sees preedge -Inf; later retirements see +0.
chunk_boundary.other_memory: Q loaded once per head; Q/W each1632, K/V each14688. V order remains column-major then all causal keys; K/V head mapping is head//6.
chunk_boundary.rounding: Independent integer 1/n -> FP32 RNE -> BF16 RNE for n1..17; direct BF16 nearest happens to agree on this closed set, not a general double-rounding claim. 1/17=FP32 0x3d70f0f1, BF16 0x3d71.
chunk_boundary.selected_index: Local selected0..15 resets to0 at second chunk; only valid scoreWrite index is global base+selected, ending16.

clock_and_resource.limits: New cap/budget are a separate version, never an extension of a running or prior failed process. Log bound covers successful exact-format output, not arbitrary failure diagnostics. Final ELF size, resource fit and actual completion remain unmeasured.
clock_and_resource.proof: Each accepted memory request consumes disjoint preedge slots a,a+1,a+2 in memReq/memRsp. Successful completion drains the last request. These FSM slots cannot overlap vector states, so add8964 vector slots. Merely multiplying accept spacing without nonoverlap would not suffice.

controls.candidate_draft_corrections: Before freeze only: an overbroad decimal 100000 replacement had changed Q base to 0x500000; restored original 0x100000 and narrowed replacement. Log continuity originally used (token,head); changed to (token,head,keyBase). Both fixes verified on final bytes. No model attempted or old frozen evidence modified.

log_gate.scope: Synthetic log PASS is not execution or numerical proof. Actual producer must also bind binary identity, exit0, cleanup, resource limits and pre/post endpoint pins. Memory/PV payloads are future source-bound executed passive assertions, not externally replayable raw packet logs.
log_gate.sequence: READY, complete ordered OBS, exact CASE_PASS, final DONE; unexpected/duplicate/fatal/unknown lines rejected.
log_gate.terminal: Exact 216 groups/result/done,1728QK,14688PV,32640memory,1836writes and recorded token16/head0 prefix0..16. Holds bounded individually with accurate uncovered ports; not a unique stall-cycle measure.
log_gate.within_chunk: Consecutive cycles enforced on (token,head,keyBase); chunk-to-chunk intervals may contain the real K reads/handshakes. Raw actual review must check complete sequence again.

metrics_boundary.bookkeeping: 28512 scripted accounting steps are not measured FMA counts. Nominal algorithm dimensions or service issues must not be mixed with actual operation counters.
metrics_boundary.phase_occupancy: Only after actual terminal,8964/observed body edges may be reported as ordered-vector phase occupancy, not MAC duty.

source_delta.group_assertions: At actual group accept, compare original observed token/head/global key to independent group row and exact monotonically increasing tag; 216 complete checkedGroups. The external group packet does not carry the core-local packedKeys value; count correctness is constrained through chunk sequence and bounded retired events.
source_delta.new_observations: Use already present observation_key as keyBase in raw OBS and passive checks; global scoreIndex=base+localSelected. No new RTL probe or feedback.

source_delta.tile: All 4096 tile positions audited for each local count1..16: active diagonal local keys<count are +0, all other entries qNaN. Tail group count1 ignores 15 inactive key lanes; no nonzero/asymmetric active data is added.
